correctness.rationale: For every smooth lambda and q of characteristic at least 5, the geometric 28-bitangent list is complete. The sign/mixed/coordinate zero line contact equations have discriminants -3, 3-lambda, and -2lambda(1+kappa^2). Frobenius fixedness is derived using base-field quadratic characters and Norm(delta)=16lambda^2/(lambda+2) from Fq2 to Fq. The two hyperflex values lambda=0,3 are separated; the Jacobi sum gives the exact six-degree-four-place parameter frequency. The dependency-free independently structured computation enumerates every smooth parameter in eight prime fields and confirms full cycles.
